welcome_lead: Henry, Mifflin-St Jeor, and the equations behind a calorie target.
meta_desc: A-Level Food Tech: BMR equations and applications.

concepts.def: Basal Metabolic Rate — energy at rest, post-absorptive state.
UK BMR equation (Henry 2005), used by SACN.
Body mass excluding fat — main BMR driver.

walkthroughs.body_html: For 18-30 year males (UK Henry equation, 2005): BMR (MJ/d) = 0.063 × weight (kg) + 2.896. SACN adopted Henry equations for UK DRV calculations.
For men (Mifflin-St Jeor, 1990, kcal/day): BMR = 10W + 6.25H − 5A + 5. For women: subtract 161 instead of +5. W = kg, H = cm, A = years.
Equations vary by 5-10% from indirect calorimetry. Lean body mass is the strongest predictor of BMR — equations underestimate athletes and overestimate sedentary obese individuals.
